purpose: Compile the project. Safe and non-mutating to source. Frequent dev-loop operation.
Run the test suite. Read-only against source; may write test results to bin/. Common SWE/QA tool.
Restore NuGet packages. Writes to obj/ and possibly modifies package lock; usually benign.
Apply code formatting. Modifies source files according to .editorconfig. Reversible.
USE WITH CAUTION — Build and execute the application. Side-effects depend on the app (DB writes, file I/O).
HIGH RISK — Produce release artifacts. Writes to bin/Release or publish folder; can trigger unintended deployments if CI consumes the output folder.
HIGH RISK — Entity Framework migrations and DB operations. Can alter database schema. Avoid in production-pointing config.
HIGH RISK — NuGet package management (push, delete, etc.). Mutates the shared package feed; destructive actions cannot be undone. Avoid unless intentional.
HIGH RISK — Install a .NET global or local tool. Mutates machine or repo tool manifest. Enable only when deliberately installing tooling.
HIGH RISK — Uninstall a .NET global or local tool. Reverses a tool install; affects machine or repo tool manifest. Enable only when deliberately removing tooling.
